distortion_model: rd = ru*(1 + k1*ru^2), normalized radius r=1 at ellipse edge
notes: USAF images are synthetic USAF-style triads for numerical validation; not a certified reproduction of ISO/USAF chart artwork.
Gaussian MTF theory assumes continuous Gaussian PSF. Rasterization and Pillow GaussianBlur can introduce small deviations.
Ideal edge uses supersampling and Lanczos downsampling, so it is anti-aliased rather than a mathematically perfect binary sampled edge.
